dedupe_keys.name: heat demands potentials for district heating and waste heat at nuts2 level idesignres

description: This data set gives heat demand, district heating potential and waste heat potential for European regions at NUTS2 level. It was published by Marina Georgati and Steffen Nielsen within the iDesignRES project, work package 1, tasks 1.1 and 1.3, which collected data and built GIS models of heat demand, district heating potentials and waste heat sources across Europe. It holds aggregated estimates of heat demand in residential and service buildings, district heating potential covering residential, service and industrial sectors with investment costs for a 55% market share, and waste heat potential split by source and temperature level. Coverage is all EU-27 countries and the United Kingdom at NUTS2 level; the 55% share is an accumulated EU-27 figure that varies between countries. Files are a small ZIP of tables and a PDF description on Zenodo (May 2025) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: values are model estimates aggregated from higher-resolution GIS work, and the market share assumption drives the costs. Simulation uses are district heating and waste heat planning in European energy system models. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
